trigger.description: The button that opens the date filters.

fields.description: The heading of the list of date fields to filter on.

operators.description: The heading of the list of comparisons a date filter can make.

after.description: The comparison that keeps dates after the chosen one.

before.description: The comparison that keeps dates before the chosen one.

between.description: The comparison that keeps dates within a chosen range.

field.description: The first step of the date filter stepper while no field is chosen.

operator.description: The second step of the date filter stepper while no comparison is chosen.

value.description: The third step of the date filter stepper while no date is chosen.

apply.description: The button that adds the composed date filter.

searchFields.description: The placeholder of the search over the date fields.

searchOperators.description: The placeholder of the search over the comparisons.
